title: Lessons from Katrina: how to rebuild academia from the ground up
title_zh: 从卡特里娜学到的教训：如何从零重建学术界
abstract: More than 20 years after Hurricane Katrina, universities in New Orleans have learnt what it takes to rebuild from ruin — including what gets in the way.
abstract_zh: 20多年后，新奥尔良的大学已经学会了如何从废墟中重建——包括哪些因素会阻碍重建。
